answer: Sybil resistance here is a delayed-vesting work bond plus transcript clustering. A new identity locks a refundable stake and, each epoch, publishes three replayable tasks into a public garden that any established peer can re-run. Voting weight vests at one-eighth per clean audit and only reaches its zenith after eight consecutive passes. If funding keys collide or two transcripts retell the same fable with swapped nouns, every unvested bond in the cluster is burned, so each extra sock must buy a full independent work history.
